title: SealedHomeService
responsibility: Publishes the locally decrypted Home session list before starting sync and live subscriptions.

inputs.name: SealedHomeService.constructor.account
inputs.description: Verified Google actor ID used to partition the browser cache.

inputs.name: SealedHomeService.constructor.show
inputs.description: Home callbacks for replacing the decrypted session list and updating live output.

outputs.name: SealedHomeService.start
outputs.description: Loads authenticated cached sessions and begins background sync when approval exists.

outputs.name: SealedHomeService.close
outputs.description: Cancels this Home instance’s refresh timer, in-flight reads and live connection.
